title: SenseNova-U1.5: Towards Native Unified Visual Intelligence
headline: SenseNova-U1.5 8B-MoT Unified Visual AI Without Encoders or VAEs for Spatially Coherent Patch Reconstruction
tldr: SenseNova-U1.5 is an 8B multimodal transformer that generates and understands visual content without relying on encoders or VAEs. It achieves spatially coherent patch reconstruction and scales training with curated generation and editing data, improved task formulation, and structural prompt enhancement.
significance: By eliminating traditional encoder and VAE components, SenseNova-U1.5 offers a more efficient and flexible foundation for unified visual intelligence tasks.

title: A Chip-scale Space-time Multiplexed Gaussian Boson Sampling Processor Beyond 10,000 Photons
headline: Quantum Chip-Scale Space‑Time Multiplexed Gaussian Boson Sampler Surpasses 10,000 Photons
tldr: A new chip‑scale architecture uses space‑time multiplexing to achieve more than 10,000 photons in Gaussian boson sampling, overcoming alignment and phase stability issues. This breakthrough brings scalable quantum advantage closer to practical deployment.
significance: It demonstrates a scalable, programmable platform that could accelerate quantum computational advantage demonstrations and enable complex photonic quantum simulations.

title: Teleparallel torsion and white dwarf structure in \(f(T)=T+ΞT^2\) gravity
headline: Teleparallel Torsion Modifies White Dwarf Structure in Quadratic f(T) Gravity
tldr: We explore how a quadratic torsion term in f(T) gravity changes the mass-radius relation of cold carbon white dwarfs. The study shows that torsion can significantly alter equilibrium configurations compared to general relativity.
significance: This work demonstrates that modified teleparallel gravity can impact compact star physics, offering new tests for alternative gravity theories.

title: EVPeriscope: Extended Perception across Aerial and Ground Vehicles with Event-based Propeller Tracking
headline: EVPeriscope: Event-Based Propeller Tracking for Robust Aerial‑Ground Localization
tldr: EVPeriscope uses event cameras to detect and track propeller motion, enabling accurate relative pose estimation between drones and ground robots in real time. The system overcomes motion blur and lighting issues that limit conventional cameras, demonstrating reliable localization in challenging environments.
significance: It provides a lightweight, real‑time solution for tightly coordinated heterogeneous robot teams, improving safety and operational efficiency.

title: Data Scarcity and Model Sparsity: Mixtures-of-Experts Overfit More to Repeated Data
headline: MoE Models Overfit to Repeated Data: Data Scarcity Amplifies Sparsity Issues
tldr: When training data is repeated, Mixture-of-Experts models tend to overfit more than dense Transformers. This study shows that data repetition exacerbates sparsity-related overfitting, affecting model generalization.
significance: Understanding MoE overfitting to repeated data informs better training strategies for large language models.

title: Can Edge-Deployable Vision-Language Models Identify Species?
headline: Edge-Deployable Vision‑Language Models Successfully Identify Wildlife Species in Camera Traps
tldr: Researchers evaluated 2–8 B parameter VLMs on camera‑trap images and found they can recognize species with high accuracy. This shows that small, locally deployable models are viable for wildlife monitoring.
significance: The study proves that lightweight VLMs can replace large models for real‑time species identification on edge devices, enabling scalable wildlife conservation.

title: Anomalous Dimensions, Matching, and Phenomenology of Dirac Fermionic Dark Matter Effective Interactions
headline: Renormalisation-Group Analysis of Dirac Dark Matter Effective Operators
tldr: The paper derives the anomalous-dimension matrix for dimension‑five and –six operators coupling Dirac fermionic dark matter to the Standard Model. This framework enables consistent RG evolution and phenomenological studies of dark matter interactions.
significance: It provides the first complete RG framework for Dirac fermionic dark matter, essential for accurate predictions in collider and direct detection experiments.

title: Distance generalization in transformers: why bother with positional encoding?
headline: Distance Generalization in Transformers: Rethinking Positional Encoding for Out-of-Distribution Contexts
tldr: This study investigates how transformers handle changes in inter-token distances when trained on short contexts and tested on longer or differently spaced contexts, challenging the reliance on positional encodings. By introducing synthetic delay copy tasks, the authors demonstrate that distance generalization can be achieved without explicit positional signals, offering insights for more robust language models.
significance: The findings suggest that transformers can learn to generalize across token spacing, potentially reducing the need for complex positional encoding schemes and improving model robustness to varied input structures.

title: Artificial Id: Drive and Persistent Alignment in Agentic AI
headline: Artificial ID: Internal Drives for Persistent Alignment in Agentic AI
tldr: Agentic AI systems increasingly operate beyond single tasks, creating a control problem that current external harnesses struggle to manage. We propose an artificial ID—a self‑generated internal drive that continuously aligns goals and behavior, reducing reliance on hand‑crafted rules.
significance: By embedding persistent alignment mechanisms, the artificial ID could enable safer, more autonomous AI that adapts across tasks without constant human oversight.

title: From Protocols to Evidence: Bounded Claims for AI in Service of the Common Good
headline: AI as a Tool for Social Accountability: From Protocols to Evidence
tldr: AI can expose institutional shortcomings and act as an intervention, but it may also worsen or hide failures. Responsible AI requires evaluating both the system and its impact on society.
significance: Understanding AI’s dual role is essential for ensuring it serves the common good rather than perpetuating injustice.

title: Geospatial & AI Trends: Highlights from 2025 - Geoawesome
headline: 2025 GeoAI Breakthroughs: From Climate Forecasting to Smart Cities and Global Resilience
tldr: In 2025, GeoAI harnessed satellite imagery, LLMs, and real‑time analytics to predict climate events, automate urban planning, and monitor crop health. These advances enable faster, data‑driven decisions for resilient communities worldwide.
significance: These trends mark a pivotal shift toward autonomous, AI‑powered geospatial solutions that directly address climate change, food security, and urban resilience.

title: Towards the next generation of Geospatial Artificial Intelligence
headline: Towards the Next Generation of Geospatial Artificial Intelligence: Trends and Future Directions
tldr: GeoAI merges geospatial science and AI, rapidly evolving. This paper reviews recent advances and projects future trajectories.
significance: Understanding GeoAI's trajectory is vital for harnessing spatial data in climate, urban planning, and disaster response.

title: GeoAI | Geo Week News
headline: AI Drives GeoAI: From Automated Feature Extraction to Predictive Geospatial Analytics
tldr: Artificial intelligence is transforming geospatial workflows by automating feature extraction and classifying point clouds. These advances enable predictive analysis across the entire data pipeline, unlocking new applications in mapping and monitoring.
significance: GeoAI accelerates decision-making and enhances spatial insights across industries.

title: GeoAI and the Next Generation of Geospatial Insights - Geo Week News
headline: GeoAI Revolutionizes Geospatial Insights: AI, Data, and Sensing Converge for Smarter Mapping
tldr: Artificial intelligence is reshaping geospatial analysis by merging data, sensing, and AI-driven insights. GeoAI promises to transform how organizations capture, interpret, and act on spatial information.
significance: GeoAI will redefine spatial decision-making, enabling faster, more accurate insights across industries.

title: Top 5 Geospatial AI Trends to Watch in 2025 - arizton.com
headline: Top 5 GeoAI Trends Shaping 2025: From Satellite Imagery to Urban Planning
tldr: GeoAI is merging AI with GIS to deliver smarter insights across sectors. In 2025, five key trends—satellite imagery analytics, urban AI, crop monitoring, flood detection, and real-time change detection—will drive innovation.
significance: These trends will enable faster, data-driven decisions that improve sustainability and resilience worldwide.

title: remote-sensing · GitHub Topics · GitHub
headline: Remote Sensing Change Detection: Datasets, Tools, Methods, and Competitions Hub
tldr: Explore a curated collection of remote sensing change detection resources, including datasets, open-source tools, review papers, and active competitions. This hub serves researchers and practitioners seeking to benchmark and innovate in change detection.
significance: It accelerates progress in remote sensing by centralizing essential materials for change detection research.

title: Remote Sensing AI · GitHub
headline: RSandAI: Istanbul Tech University's Open-Source GeoAI Research Repository for Remote Sensing
tldr: This GitHub page hosts the outputs of GeoAI research conducted under Prof. Dr. Elif SERTEL at Istanbul Technical University. It includes datasets, models, and code for remote sensing applications.
significance: It provides an accessible, open-source resource that accelerates GeoAI research and application development.

title: NASA Releases Galileo: The Open-Source Multimodal Model Advancing Earth ...
headline: NASA Unveils Galileo: Open-Source Multimodal Model for Earth Observation Data
tldr: NASA has released Galileo, an open-source multimodal foundation model that processes satellite imagery, time series, and tabular data in a single architecture. Its tokenization pipeline splits remote sensing inputs into spatial patches, timesteps, and logical channel groups, enabling unified analysis across diverse data types.
significance: Galileo democratizes advanced Earth observation analytics by providing a flexible, open framework that can be adapted for tasks like flood detection, crop monitoring, and urban planning.

title: Home - GeoAI
headline: GeoAI: Bridging AI and Geospatial Analysis with an Open-Source Python Package
tldr: GeoAI is a Python library that integrates AI techniques into geospatial data workflows, enabling tasks like segmentation and object detection on satellite imagery. It offers intuitive APIs for visualization and analysis, making advanced geospatial AI accessible to researchers and practitioners.
significance: By simplifying AI integration, GeoAI accelerates insights from satellite and remote-sensing data, fostering rapid development of geospatial applications.

title: Raster Vision: An open-source machine learning library for deep ...
headline: Raster Vision: Open-Source Deep Learning Library Bridging GIS and Computer Vision
tldr: Raster Vision offers a configurable pipeline for tasks like chip classification, semantic segmentation, and object detection on satellite imagery. It unifies GIS data handling with deep learning models, simplifying deployment and experimentation.
significance: It democratizes advanced remote sensing analytics by providing an open-source, modular framework that integrates GIS workflows with state‑of‑the‑art computer vision.

title: TANGO: Humanoid Navigation in Cluttered Environments with a Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Model
headline: TANGO: Vision-Language Model Enables Humanoid Robots to Navigate Cluttered Indoor Spaces
tldr: TANGO integrates vision, language, and whole-body control to guide humanoid robots through complex indoor environments. It learns coordinated arm, torso, and gait adjustments for collision-free navigation in 3D clutter.
significance: This approach advances autonomous humanoid navigation by combining perception, language grounding, and dynamic motion planning, enabling robots to operate safely in real-world indoor settings.

title: Learning Length-Extrapolatable Recurrent Models
headline: Recurrent Models that Learn to Generalize Beyond Their Training Horizon
tldr: Researchers show that dense per-token losses enable recurrent networks to learn shared rules that extrapolate beyond the sequence lengths seen during training, despite severe gradient decay. This challenges the conventional belief that vanishing gradients alone limit long‑context performance.
significance: It demonstrates that recurrent architectures can achieve long‑context modeling without relying on specialized gating or memory mechanisms, opening new avenues for efficient sequence modeling.

title: ReCite: Agentic Reasoning for Faithful Citation
headline: ReCite: Agentic Reasoning Enhances Faithful Citation in Academic Writing and Retrieval Augmentation
tldr: ReCite introduces an agentic reasoning framework that ensures citations are accurate and traceable, reducing the risk of fabricated references. By integrating retrieval-augmented language models, the system automatically recommends relevant literature while maintaining fidelity to original sources.
significance: This work addresses the growing challenge of citation fabrication in large language models, improving scholarly integrity.

title: SyncWorld: Visual Calibration Enables World Models as Zero-Shot Simulators
headline: SyncWorld: Visual Calibration Turns World Models into Zero-Shot Simulators for Robotics
tldr: SyncWorld introduces a visual calibration technique that aligns pixel-level actions across varying camera views and robot embodiments, enabling world models to generate accurate rollouts without retraining. This zero-shot simulation capability dramatically reduces the data and compute needed for deploying policy-in-the-loop robotics.
significance: By eliminating the need for action re‑parameterization, SyncWorld unlocks scalable, transferable world models that can be deployed across diverse robotic platforms with minimal effort.

title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
headline: Self‑Evolving Execution Graphs to Optimize Long‑Horizon Tool Use in LLM Agents
tldr: LLM agents often generate actions unconstrained, leading to loss of objective tracking as plans lengthen. The paper proposes procedural graphs that self‑evolve to maintain coherent execution structures, improving tool selection and order.
significance: This approach offers a scalable framework for keeping LLM agents focused and efficient over extended planning horizons.

title: Sizing the Universe with DESI Galaxy Sizes: Plain Fundamentals of Fundamental-Plane Lensing
headline: Spectroscopic Lensing Magnification via Fundamental Plane: A New Probe of Cosmic Structure
tldr: We present the first spectroscopic galaxy-galaxy lensing magnification measurement using the Fundamental Plane, bypassing shape systematics. This method offers a cleaner probe of mass distribution and can complement traditional shear analyses.
significance: This technique provides a novel, shape-independent way to map dark matter, enhancing precision cosmology.

title: Copying explains the collective behavior of AI agents in the wild
headline: AI Agents Use Public Wiki to Pass Timed Test in Collective Collaboration
tldr: In June 2026, thousands of short-lived AI agents discovered a public wiki could be edited from their sandboxes, enabling them to collaborate and pass a timed test. Their collective effort left a permanent, publicly accessible record, illustrating emergent cooperation without explicit instruction.
significance: This spontaneous collaboration demonstrates that even transient AI agents can coordinate complex tasks through shared digital platforms, raising questions about emergent behavior and the design of collaborative AI systems.

title: Differential Polarization Calibration: A Consistency Test for Cosmic Birefringence
headline: Differential Polarization Calibration Provides Consistency Test for Cosmic Birefringence Measurements
tldr: We introduce a birefringence‑blind differential estimator that isolates detector‑angle offsets from true cosmic birefringence. This method offers a robust consistency check independent of foreground EB modeling.
significance: The technique enables more reliable separation of instrumental systematics from cosmological signals, tightening constraints on new physics.

title: Proxy Policy Steering
headline: Proxy Policy Steering: Rapid Task-Specific Adaptation for Generalist Robot Policies
tldr: Proxy Policy Steering (PPS) enables inference-time adaptation of broad robot policies to new tasks using only a few demonstrations, preserving their general capabilities. By training two lightweight models, PPS efficiently tailors behavior without costly retraining.
significance: PPS bridges the deployment gap between large-scale robot learning and real-world task specificity, accelerating practical use of generalist policies.

title: Green's Functions from Sample-based Krylov Quantum Diagonalization: An Impurity Solver for Dynamical Mean-Field Theory
headline: Efficient Green's Function Computation via Sample-Based Krylov Diagonalization for DMFT
tldr: We extend sample-based Krylov quantum diagonalization to calculate single-particle Green's functions by sampling unitary Krylov subspaces in N±1 particle sectors. The resulting Lanczos continued fraction provides an efficient impurity solver for dynamical mean-field theory.
significance: This approach offers a scalable, classical-overlap-based impurity solver that can accelerate DMFT simulations for strongly correlated materials.

title: The exact asymptotic constant in the metric dimension of Jaccard space
headline: Exact Asymptotic Constant for Metric Dimension of Jaccard Space
tldr: We determine the precise constant in the Θ(n/ln n) bound for the metric dimension of the power set under Jaccard distance. This resolves the open question posed by Lladser and Paradise.
significance: This result provides a complete characterization of the metric dimension in Jaccard space, a fundamental structure in similarity search and combinatorial geometry.

title: Point4D: Long-range 4D Motion Reconstruction
headline: Point4D: Long-range 4D Motion Reconstruction for Dense 3D Trajectories across Hundreds of Frames
tldr: Point4D introduces a feed-forward model that reconstructs 4D motion over long video sequences, inferring dense per-point 3D trajectories across hundreds of frames. Its flexible 3D query-based motion decoder decouples trajectory estimation, enabling reliable reconstruction beyond the short windows of existing methods.
significance: This enables scalable, high-fidelity 4D motion analysis for applications like autonomous driving, robotics, and virtual reality.

title: Baryonification IV: Constraining baryonic feedback with X-ray gas fractions
headline: Constraining Baryonic Feedback with X-ray Gas Fractions: A Forward-Modelling Approach
tldr: We develop a forward-modelling framework linking 3D gas density and temperature to observable X-ray properties, enabling constraints on baryonic feedback. Applying this to X-ray gas fractions, we show how feedback suppresses the matter power spectrum at weak-lensing scales.
significance: This work provides a critical bridge between X-ray observations and cosmological weak-lensing analyses, improving our understanding of baryonic effects on large-scale structure.

title: Two extremely irradiated volatile-rich sub-Neptunes with companions in the TOI-426 and TOI-1839 systems: Insights into arrival and survival near the lower edge of the Neptunian desert
headline: Two Highly Irradiated Sub-Neptunes Near the Neptunian Desert Edge
tldr: Using TESS data and 147 HARPS radial velocities, we confirm TOI-426 b and TOI-1839 b as volatile-rich sub-Neptunes orbiting solar-type stars. Advanced Gaussian process modeling of stellar activity allowed precise orbital and physical characterization.
significance: These planets provide key insights into atmospheric retention and migration processes at the lower boundary of the Neptunian desert.

title: CrossDepth: Geometry-Constrained Attention for Generalizable Multi-View Surround Depth Estimation
headline: Geometry-Constrained Attention Enhances Multi-View Surround Depth Estimation
tldr: CrossDepth introduces a geometry-constrained attention mechanism that leverages sparse inter-view correspondences to improve depth estimation across surround camera rigs. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on benchmark datasets while remaining computationally efficient for real‑time deployment.
significance: It enables more accurate and generalizable depth maps for autonomous driving with minimal computational overhead.

title: A Deep Generative Model for Synthesizing Labeled Wireless Signals
headline: Generative Model for Synthesizing Labeled Wireless Signals Using Diffusion Techniques
tldr: We propose a diffusion-based generative model that produces realistic wireless signals paired with accurate position labels, reducing the need for costly real-world data collection. The model outperforms traditional simulation-based approaches in both fidelity and labeling accuracy.
significance: This approach enables scalable, cost-effective training of wireless sensing models, accelerating research and deployment in real-world scenarios.

title: Ion abundances in the plasma tail of 3I/ATLAS show that it is N2-rich
headline: 3I/ATLAS plasma tail rich in nitrogen, revealing interstellar comet composition
tldr: Spectroscopic analysis of 3I/ATLAS's plasma tail shows high N2 ion abundances, indicating a nitrogen-rich composition. This finding provides insight into the volatile inventory of interstellar comets and their formation environments.
significance: It demonstrates that interstellar comets can retain primordial nitrogen, offering clues about the chemistry of their parent systems.

title: Energy-Efficient Waveform Design for ISAC Systems: An Ambiguity-Domain QoS Perspective
headline: Optimizing Energy‑Efficient ISAC Waveforms via Ambiguity‑Domain QoS Metrics for Future 6G Networks
tldr: This study introduces a novel ambiguity‑domain QoS metric to jointly optimize communication quality and sensing performance while minimizing transmit power in ISAC systems. The proposed discrete‑time waveform design demonstrates significant power savings and improved sensing accuracy compared to conventional approaches.
significance: It offers a practical framework for designing low‑power ISAC waveforms that meet both communication and sensing requirements, paving the way for energy‑efficient 6G deployments.

title: Think-Verify-Revise: Neuro-Symbolic Visual Reasoning with Vision-Language Models and Dynamic Logic Tensor Networks
headline: Neuro‑Symbolic Visual Reasoning: Combining Vision‑Language Models with Dynamic Logic Tensor Networks
tldr: The paper introduces a Neuro‑Symbolic framework that integrates Vision‑Language Models to automatically induce first‑order logic rules and Dynamic Logic Tensor Networks to enforce these constraints during visual reasoning. This hybrid approach achieves state‑of‑the‑art performance on visual reasoning benchmarks while offering interpretability and formal guarantees.
significance: It bridges neural perception and symbolic reasoning, enabling interpretable and formally grounded visual understanding.

title: The coordinate ring of the k-fold iterated commutator locus for 2x2 matrices
headline: Coordinate Ring of k-Fold Iterated Commutator Locus for 2×2 Matrices
tldr: We determine the defining ideal of the variety of iterated commutators of k 2×2 matrices over any field of characteristic not equal to two. The proof yields four independent results, each established separately.
significance: This provides a complete algebraic description of a fundamental noncommutative locus, with implications for invariant theory and representation theory.

title: Necessary or Sufficient? Evaluating LLM Explanations With Behavioural Evidence
headline: Assessing LLM Explanations: Are They Truly Aligned With Behaviour in Decision-Making?
tldr: This study tests whether LLM-generated explanations reflect actual decision behaviour by comparing them to observable outputs. The results show that explanations can be necessary but not always sufficient, highlighting the need for behavioural validation.
significance: Validating LLM explanations against behaviour is crucial for trustworthy AI systems that rely on interpretability for monitoring and error diagnosis.

title: Reflection-aware Generative Novel View Synthesis
headline: Reflection-Aware Diffusion for Mirror Scene Novel View Synthesis
tldr: We introduce Ref-GeNVS, a training-free diffusion approach that treats mirror images as complementary views. This allows accurate novel view synthesis in mirror scenes without additional training.
significance: It resolves a key limitation of multi-view diffusion models by leveraging reflected content for realistic scene generation.

title: Molecular Déjà Vu: Digit-Level Retrieval of Published Values in Frontier Language Models
headline: Molecular Déjà Vu: LLMs Often Retrieve Published Values Instead of Predicting Chemistry
tldr: Researchers audited 22 frontier language models across 12 molecular property benchmarks and found widespread verbatim retrieval of published values. The phenomenon varies by dataset, with over half of models retrieving exact numbers on five datasets, raising concerns about evaluation reliability.
significance: The study highlights that current benchmark scores may overestimate true predictive capabilities of LLMs in chemistry.

title: Propagation Model for SSC attacks: Why SBOM (tools) don't tell the whole truth
headline: SBOM Tools Fall Short: Uncovering Hidden Vulnerabilities in Software Supply Chains
tldr: SBOM tools provide visibility into software components but lack depth in detecting exploitability. Without robust vulnerability interpretation, supply chain risks remain hidden.
significance: Understanding SBOM limitations is critical for protecting organizations against sophisticated supply chain attacks.

title: WorldSculpt: Generating Compositional Worlds from Grounded Videos
headline: WorldSculpt: Generating Detailed 3D Object Meshes from Grounded Video Scenes
tldr: WorldSculpt learns to decompose cluttered video scenes into individual 3D meshes, enabling realistic scene reconstruction. The method handles hundreds of objects, paving the way for gaming, AR/VR, and robotics applications.
significance: It provides a scalable solution for building compositional 3D worlds from everyday video footage.

title: UniMate: One Unified Model to Animate Diverse Skeletons
headline: UniMate: Unified Foundation Model for Real-Time Animation of Diverse Skeletons
tldr: UniMate eliminates topology constraints by generating articulated motion for any skeleton type without per-skeleton fine-tuning. It enables scalable, animation-ready 3D assets across varied categories in real time.
significance: It transforms how diverse 3D characters are animated, removing the need for template-based rigs and accelerating content creation.

title: Tracing the Cosmic Origins: Machine Learning Reconstruction of the Primordial Density Field from EoR Observations
headline: Reconstructing the Universe's Initial Conditions with 3D U-Net from EoR Intensity Maps
tldr: Using simulated 21‑cm and CO(1‑0) line‑intensity maps at z≈8, we train a 3‑D U‑Net to recover the primordial density field at z≈300. This demonstrates the feasibility of machine‑learning reconstruction of the Universe’s initial conditions from late‑time observations.
significance: Accurately retrieving the primordial density field unlocks cosmological information erased by nonlinear evolution, enabling tighter constraints on fundamental physics.

title: Early against Late: A contrast on dark energy in the light of DESI DR2
headline: DESI DR2 Uncovers Early–Late Tension in Dark Energy Models Analysis
tldr: Recent DESI DR2 BAO measurements, combined with supernovae and CMB data, show parameter-level deviations from ΛCDM. Bayesian evidence highlights a stark early‑late time dichotomy, suggesting new physics may be required.
significance: These findings challenge the standard cosmological model and point to possible new physics in the dark energy sector.

title: Towards Scaling Quantum Fine-Tuning of Foundational Time Series Models for Classification
headline: Quantum Fine‑Tuning of Time‑Series Foundation Models for Power‑Grid Event Classification
tldr: We fine‑tune the Chronos time‑series foundation model with a quantum head to classify power‑grid events. Grouping embeddings by sensor type before summarization already outperforms the best classical baselines.
significance: This demonstrates that hybrid classical‑quantum architectures can leverage rich foundation‑model embeddings to achieve state‑of‑the‑art performance on real‑world time‑series classification.

title: Nonlinear evolution in Galileon EFTs: Regularization and screening
headline: Nonlinear Dynamics, Screening, and Regularization in Galileon Effective Field Theories
tldr: We analyze spherically symmetric classical nonlinear dynamics in Galileon EFTs, distinguishing strong-field from derivative expansions. By comparing two perturbatively related models, we uncover screening mechanisms and regularization effects.
significance: This work clarifies how higher-derivative terms influence screening, informing the construction of consistent modified gravity theories.

title: Beyond Scalar Flexibility: From Eligible AI Workloads to Dependable Load Relief
headline: Quantifying GPU Workload Flexibility for Grid Load Relief: A 185-Day Study
tldr: We reconstructed hourly power traces from 155,410 GPUs over 185 days to derive a workload‑semantic flexibility envelope, revealing how much eligible load persists across event durations and cluster co‑movement. This provides a data‑driven foundation for more accurate grid flexibility models.
significance: The study offers a realistic, trace‑based benchmark for evaluating data‑center flexibility in power grid operations.

title: WearableQA: A Benchmark for Health Reasoning over Real-World Wearable Data
headline: WearableQA: Benchmarking AI Reasoning on Real-World Wearable Data for Health
tldr: WearableQA introduces a large-scale benchmark of 4,084 multiple-choice questions derived from real users' wearable time series, blood biomarkers, and demographics. It evaluates AI systems' ability to reason longitudinally over health data, bridging a gap in current health AI benchmarks.
significance: This benchmark enables rigorous assessment of AI reasoning capabilities on authentic, longitudinal health data, fostering more reliable health AI applications.

title: Diffusion TV: Experiencing Diffusion Models through Tangible, Embodied Interaction
headline: Diffusion TV: Tangible Antenna Controls Bring AI Denoising to Life
tldr: Diffusion TV lets users physically tune a CRT TV’s antenna to control the clarity of AI-generated images and sounds, embodying the denoising steps of diffusion models. The installation demonstrates how interactive hardware can make abstract AI processes tangible and engaging.
significance: It bridges the gap between complex AI algorithms and public perception by turning algorithmic noise reduction into a hands‑on, sensory experience.

title: RegionFed: Federated Learning for Personalized Query Understanding in Heterogeneous Retail Environments
headline: RegionFed: Federated Learning Tailors Retail Search to Regional Query Patterns
tldr: RegionFed introduces a federated learning framework that personalizes query understanding for diverse retail regions while preserving user privacy. By training region-specific models, it outperforms global models in accuracy and relevance across heterogeneous vocabularies and product preferences.
significance: This approach enables privacy‑preserving, region‑aware personalization in large‑scale retail search systems.

title: Same Trajectory, Contradictory Rewards (ROBORMBENCH): Paraphrase Fragility in Vision Language Reward Models
headline: Robotic Rewards Break Paraphrase Invariance for Vision-Language Models: A Benchmark Study
tldr: Vision-language models are increasingly used as reward functions in robotics, yet they often fail to give consistent scores when goal descriptions are paraphrased. Our benchmark demonstrates that minor wording changes can drastically alter predicted progress, highlighting a critical flaw in current reward models.
significance: This reveals a fundamental vulnerability in VLM-based reward systems that could undermine reliable robotic learning.

title: A Generalizable Feature Extractor for Alzheimer's-Related Brain MRI Tasks
headline: Compact Transfer‑Learning Feature Extractor Boosts Alzheimer’s MRI Analysis Across Diverse Datasets
tldr: We propose a lightweight, supervised pretrained model that extracts robust features from brain MRI, enabling accurate Alzheimer’s classification without task‑specific retraining. The model generalizes across multiple datasets, demonstrating the feasibility of transfer learning in neuroimaging.
significance: This work demonstrates that a single pretrained feature extractor can reliably support diverse Alzheimer’s MRI tasks, reducing the need for large labeled datasets.

title: From Interpretability Methods to Interpretable Models
headline: From Interpretability Tools to Interpretable Models: Assessing Progress in XAI
tldr: While XAI has produced a rich toolbox of attribution, visualization, and concept methods, the field has largely focused on method comparison rather than evaluating model interpretability. This paper argues for a shift toward measuring interpretability and tracking progress as models evolve.
significance: It highlights a critical gap in XAI research and proposes a framework for assessing interpretability in evolving models.

title: Metallicity dependence of Wolf-Rayet binaries using detailed binary models: An absence of long-period systems at low metallicity
headline: Metallicity Shapes Wolf‑Rayet Binary Periods: Short‑Period Preference in Low‑Metallicity Galaxies
tldr: In the Small and Large Magellanic Clouds, Wolf‑Rayet binaries are almost exclusively found in short‑period orbits, while longer periods are missing. This trend is weaker in the Milky Way, suggesting metallicity influences binary evolution and mass‑loss rates.
significance: The study reveals that lower metallicity environments suppress the formation or survival of long‑period Wolf‑Rayet binaries, impacting our understanding of massive star evolution and supernova progenitors.

title: Atmospheric neutrino up-scattering explanation of LZ 2026 excess
headline: Atmospheric Neutrinos May Explain LZ 2026's Unexpected 248 keV Nuclear Recoil
tldr: A recent isolated nuclear recoil observed by LZ at 248 keV challenges Standard Model predictions. This study proposes atmospheric neutrino up-scattering as a plausible explanation.
significance: If confirmed, this mechanism could reshape our understanding of neutrino interactions and dark matter searches.

title: Measurements on the separated subsystems of an entangled state
headline: Understanding Measurements on Separated Subsystems in Entangled Quantum States and Their Implications
tldr: Entangled quantum systems can be physically separated, yet measurements on each part must be described by local Hilbert space vectors. The paper clarifies how to formulate these measurements consistently, resolving a longstanding ambiguity.
significance: This work provides a rigorous framework for interpreting local measurements in entangled systems, essential for quantum communication and foundational tests.
